svg.title: Project: MuniSense (Phase 1 done). Exact, source-cited South African municipal electricity bills, for software and AI agents. The calculation core is built: decimal money, cited tariff values and prepaid purchases. Python 3.13 , Pydantic , 100% branch coverage. 63 commits.
